Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLIII OF 2002
SINDH ABKARI
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLIII OF
2002
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Akbari Act, 1878.
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 31st October, 2002]
No. S. Legis:1(43)/2002, dated
31-10-2002. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Abkari
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
